body:
Today’s the last day to get up to $400 off your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket

TechCrunch is offering a limited-time opportunity for attendees to secure significant discounts on passes for the highly anticipated TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 event. As of today, participants can enjoy an additional $100 off the already discounted ticket prices for founders, investors, and attendees, marking the final day to take advantage of this offer.

What happened

The announcement comes as TechCrunch ramps up preparations for its annual Disrupt event, a key gathering for entrepreneurs, investors, and tech enthusiasts. Starting today, those interested in attending can apply this new discount to their ticket purchases. This additional savings are layered on top of existing promotional pricing, allowing attendees to save up to a total of $400 depending on the type of pass they choose. The urgency of this offer is emphasized by the fact that today is the final day to secure these discounts, prompting potential attendees to act quickly.

Why it matters

TechCrunch Disrupt is a cornerstone event in the tech industry calendar, providing a platform for networking, learning, and showcasing innovation. The event attracts a diverse range of participants, including startups, established companies, and investors, all eager to engage with the latest trends and technologies. The additional discount serves not only as an incentive for attendees but also reflects TechCrunch’s commitment to making the event accessible to a broader audience. By reducing financial barriers, TechCrunch encourages participation from a wider array of innovators and thought leaders, which can enhance the overall quality of discussions and networking opportunities at the event. With the clock ticking on this discount, those interested in attending are urged to finalize their plans and secure their tickets to be part of this influential gathering.

Source: techcrunch.com.
